question: Which of the following types of mirrors show lateral inversion of light?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Plane mirror.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Lateral inversion is a phenomenon in which the right appears to be left and vice versa.
 
• Lateral inversion is a phenomenon shown by the plane mirror and also by the spherical mirrors.
 
• It occurs in the case of virtual images, as every virtual image is erect and laterally inverted.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** The three most common mirror glass types are:

 
 

 Plane Mirror
 These are flat mirrors that reflect images in their normal proportions, reversed from left to right.
 
 

 Concave Mirror
 Concave mirrors are spherical mirrors that curve inward like a spoon. They create the illusion of largeness.
 
 

 Convex Mirror
 Convex mirrors are also spherical mirrors. They bulge out and distort the reflected image, making it smaller.
